definitions.explanation: A loss recorded in a competition when a participant cannot compete, whether due to injury, absence, or disqualification, without an actual match taking place.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{不戦敗|ふせんぱい}になった。
examples.english: I lost by default due to an injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{不戦敗|ふせんぱい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The opposing team didn't show up, so it was a forfeit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大関|おおぜき}→大関：12662_oozeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}→体調不良：20233_taichoufuryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{休場|きゅうじょう}し、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取組|とりくみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不戦敗|ふせんぱい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The ōzeki withdrew due to poor health, and today's bout was recorded as a loss by default.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{不戦|ふせん}→不戦：24628_fusen⟧ (without fighting) and {敗|はい} (defeat). Commonly used in sumo, martial arts, and other competitive sports. The opposite is ⟦{不戦勝|ふせんしょう}→不戦勝：08409_fusenshou⟧ (win by default).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不戦敗|ふせんぱい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to lose by default
- {不戦敗|ふせんぱい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to have a default loss recorded
- {不戦敗|ふせんぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧: to suffer a forfeit loss

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不戦勝|ふせんしょう}→不戦勝：08409_fusenshou⟧: win by default — the counterpart; a win without fighting
- ⟦{棄権|きけん}→棄権：16194_kiken⟧: withdrawal, abstention — the act of withdrawing from a competition, which often causes a {不戦敗|ふせんぱい}
- ⟦{反則負|はんそくま}け→反則負け：22305_hansokumake⟧: loss by foul — losing due to a rule violation during an actual match
